note: City of Armour's Lions Park on US-281 beside Lake Alcazar, a small fishing pond with a walking path and dock. Camping pads, bathhouse, dump station, playground, sand volleyball and two picnic shelters; two cabins also rent. Short stays are by donation in the drop box by the bathhouse; stays of five days or more pay a daily rate set by phone. --Claude
